about: Curated, human-verified resources per topic code. Keyed by code (e.g. MIND.01). Loaded at runtime by index.html and merged over the search fallback; any code without an entry keeps its Watch/Read search links. See CURATING.md for the schema and quality rubric, and run `npm run verify-links` after every change.
knownVerifierWarnings: britannica.com, newsinhealth.nih.gov, and aeon.co bot-wall or rate-limit automated checkers, so verify-links.js reports them as WARN. All three were confirmed to return HTTP 200 in a real browser on 2026-07-16 — WARN here means 'checker was blocked', not 'link is dead'.
